name: application-input-group
title: Input Group
description: Text inputs fused with a leading icon, addon text, or trailing action button into a single visually joined control.
useWhen: An input needs a leading icon, a fixed text prefix or suffix, or a trailing action button visually fused to its border.
Building a search field, a prefixed URL/handle field, or a copy-to-clipboard field where the addon and input should read as one control.
avoidWhen: The label and control can simply stack — use a plain labeled input instead of adding an unnecessary addon.
The addon is actually a separate action unrelated to the input's value — use a standalone button next to the field instead.
responsiveBehavior: The group is a single-row flex container at all widths; the input shrinks first inside a constrained parent while addons keep their intrinsic width.
accessibility: Each input keeps a visible or programmatically associated label, even when a leading icon suggests its purpose.
Decorative icons are aria-hidden; the addon text or trailing button carries the accessible name when it conveys meaning.
Focus styles apply to the whole group via focus-within so keyboard users see one continuous focused control.

variants.title: Icon search
variants.description: A search input with a leading icon and trailing keyboard-shortcut hint fused into one bordered control.
accessibility: The search icon is aria-hidden; the visible label communicates the input's purpose to screen readers.

variants.title: Icon search (Dark)
variants.description: Icon search input adapted for dark form surfaces.
accessibility: Label, placeholder, and kbd hint colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark form backgrounds.

variants.title: Text addon with action
variants.description: An input with a fixed text prefix and a trailing copy button, all sharing one border as a single control.
accessibility: The trailing button has a visible text label ('Copy') in addition to its icon, so its action is announced by name.

variants.title: Text addon with action (Dark)
variants.description: Text addon with action adapted for dark form surfaces.
accessibility: Addon, input, and button colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark form backgrounds.
